cash_entries_rate.name: cash_entries_rate
cash_entries_rate.value: ("cash_entries"."currency" = 'VES') = ("cash_entries"."ves_rate" is not null) and ("cash_entries"."ves_rate" is null or "cash_entries"."ves_rate" > 0)

pc_commands_result_check.name: pc_commands_result_check
pc_commands_result_check.value:
("pc_commands"."last_result" is null and "pc_commands"."last_result_at" is null and "pc_commands"."status" in ('requested', 'expired', 'cancelled')) or
      ("pc_commands"."last_result" is not null and "pc_commands"."last_result_at" is not null
        and coalesce("pc_commands"."last_result"->>'status' = "pc_commands"."status", false)
        and "pc_commands"."status" in ('accepted', 'applied', 'failed'))

pc_credentials_revocation_check.name: pc_credentials_revocation_check
pc_credentials_revocation_check.value:
("pc_credentials"."revoked_at" is null or "pc_credentials"."revoked_at" >= "pc_credentials"."created_at")
    and ("pc_credentials"."revoked_by_staff_id" is null or "pc_credentials"."revoked_at" is not null)

pc_installation_codes_consumption_check.name: pc_installation_codes_consumption_check
pc_installation_codes_consumption_check.value:
("pc_installation_codes"."consumed_at" is null and "pc_installation_codes"."consumed_pc_id" is null) or
    ("pc_installation_codes"."consumed_at" is not null and "pc_installation_codes"."consumed_pc_id" is not null
      and "pc_installation_codes"."consumed_at" >= "pc_installation_codes"."created_at" and "pc_installation_codes"."consumed_at" < "pc_installation_codes"."expires_at"
      and ("pc_installation_codes"."target_pc_id" is null or "pc_installation_codes"."target_pc_id" = "pc_installation_codes"."consumed_pc_id"))

pc_maintenances_exit_fields_check.name: pc_maintenances_exit_fields_check
pc_maintenances_exit_fields_check.value:
("pc_maintenances"."ended_at" is null and "pc_maintenances"."exit_id" is null and "pc_maintenances"."duration_seconds" is null
        and "pc_maintenances"."ended_by" is null and "pc_maintenances"."exit_source" is null) or
      ("pc_maintenances"."ended_at" is not null and "pc_maintenances"."exit_id" is not null and "pc_maintenances"."duration_seconds" is not null
        and "pc_maintenances"."duration_seconds" >= 0 and "pc_maintenances"."ended_by" is not null and "pc_maintenances"."exit_source" is not null
        and coalesce("pc_maintenances"."ended_by"->>'kind' = 'staff', false) and "pc_maintenances"."exit_source" in ('local', 'panel'))

sale_lines_kind_fields.name: sale_lines_kind_fields
sale_lines_kind_fields.value:
("sale_lines"."kind" = 'product' and "sale_lines"."product_id" is not null)
        or ("sale_lines"."kind" = 'other' and "sale_lines"."product_id" is null and "sale_lines"."quantity" = 1)

sales_void_fields.name: sales_void_fields
sales_void_fields.value: ("sales"."voided_at" is null) = ("sales"."void_reason" is null) and ("sales"."voided_at" is null) = ("sales"."voided_by" is null)

session_pauses_ended_fields.name: session_pauses_ended_fields
session_pauses_ended_fields.value:
("session_pauses"."ended_at" is null) = ("session_pauses"."end_reason" is null)
        and ("session_pauses"."ended_at" is null) = ("session_pauses"."ended_by" is null)

sessions_kind_fields.name: sessions_kind_fields
sessions_kind_fields.value:
("sessions"."kind" = 'account' and "sessions"."customer_id" is not null and "sessions"."purchased_seconds" is null)
        or ("sessions"."kind" = 'temporary' and "sessions"."customer_id" is null and "sessions"."temp_name" is not null
          and "sessions"."purchased_seconds" is not null)

staff_technical_login_attempts_lock_chec.name: staff_technical_login_attempts_lock_check
staff_technical_login_attempts_lock_chec.value:
("staff_technical_login_attempts"."failed_logins" < 10 and "staff_technical_login_attempts"."locked_at" is null and "staff_technical_login_attempts"."locked_until" is null) or
      ("staff_technical_login_attempts"."failed_logins" = 10 and "staff_technical_login_attempts"."locked_at" is not null and "staff_technical_login_attempts"."locked_until" is not null
        and "staff_technical_login_attempts"."locked_until" = "staff_technical_login_attempts"."locked_at" + interval '60 seconds')

stock_movements_kind_fields.name: stock_movements_kind_fields
stock_movements_kind_fields.value:
("stock_movements"."kind" = 'restock' and "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0 and "stock_movements"."sale_id" is null)
        or ("stock_movements"."kind" = 'sale' and "stock_movements"."sale_id" is not null)
        or ("stock_movements"."kind" = 'adjustment' and "stock_movements"."reason" is not null and "stock_movements"."sale_id" is null)
        or ("stock_movements"."kind" = 'waste' and "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0 and "stock_movements"."reason" is not null
          and "stock_movements"."sale_id" is null)
